name: tes-iq-eq-v2
description: Tes IQ & EQ — satu codebase Expo (React Native + TypeScript) untuk Android, iOS, dan Windows (web dibungkus Electron). 100% offline, tanpa API.

scripts.gen: npm run gen:iq && npm run gen:eq
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:desktop && npm run validate
scripts.desktop:dev: node scripts/build-web.mjs && npm run prepare:web -w @tesiqeq/desktop && npm start -w @tesiqeq/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: node scripts/build-web.mjs && npm run prepare:web -w @tesiqeq/desktop && npm run dist -w @tesiqeq/desktop
scripts.app:deps: cd apps/app && npx expo install react react-dom react-native expo-router expo-status-bar expo-linking expo-constants react-native-screens react-native-safe-area-context react-native-web @expo/metro-runtime @react-native-async-storage/async-storage
scripts.android:apk: cd apps/app && npx eas-cli build -p android --profile preview
